title: JailPolicy
description: A jail policy: the ordered rules vulnetix jail evaluates for a repository over everything ever reported for it (vulnerabilities past their SLA, dependencies past end of life, migrations that have not landed, hygiene categories that regressed). A policy without repository is the tenant's default; a policy with one is a per-repository override that replaces the default outright. Separate from QualityGate, which judges a single scan.

metadata.description: metadata.name is stored as the policy's name.

repository.description: The repository this policy overrides the default for. Leave it out for the tenant default; a tenant has at most one default and one policy per repository.

enforcementMode.description: enforce applies each rule's onBreach. warn downgrades every breach to a warning, which disarms the jail without a CLI release.

defaultStalenessDays.description: How old the evidence a rule reads may be, in days, for rules that do not set stalenessDays.

onStale.description: What a rule does when the evidence it needs is stale or absent, for rules that do not set their own. fail is the default: a gate that passes on missing evidence is worse than no gate.

rules.description: The rules, in order. Every enabled rule is evaluated on every run; order decides presentation and which rule gives the headline reason, and never short-circuits. Rules are matched to stored rules by label, so labels must be unique within a policy.

rule.description: One rule: select a population, aggregate it, compare the result with a threshold.

kind.description: VULN: vulnerability findings. EOL: end-of-life dependencies. GOAL: a migration target, selected by targetPattern. HYGIENE: findings from the other scanner categories.

label.description: The rule's name in jail output and the console, and its key within the policy.

category.description: Only findings from this scanner category. A HYGIENE rule without one draws from SECRETS, LICENSE, IAC, OCI and MALWARE.

toolName.description: Only findings reported by this tool.

ecosystem.description: Only dependencies from this package ecosystem.

severityFloor.description: Only findings at or above this severity.

flags.description: Every flag listed must hold for a finding to count. kev: in a known-exploited catalogue. malicious: known malware. hasFix: a fixed version exists. reachable: the vulnerable code is called. direct: a direct dependency.

targetPattern.description: GOAL only, and required there: a path.Match glob over the identifier of each fact (a purl, a package name, a rule id).

aggregate.description: COUNT: how many. COUNT_PAST_SLA: how many are past the remediation window of the tenant's RemediationPolicy (VULN only). MAX_AGE_DAYS: the age of the oldest, in days. PERCENT: the share of the population, 0 to 100.

operator.description: How the aggregate is compared with the thresholds. BETWEEN and OUTSIDE use both thresholds, inclusive.

thresholdLow.description: The threshold, or the lower bound for BETWEEN and OUTSIDE.

thresholdHigh.description: The upper bound for BETWEEN and OUTSIDE; required by them. It must not be below thresholdLow.

deadline.description: GOAL only. Until this time a breach is downgraded to a warning, whatever onBreach says.

ratchet.description: GOAL only. Breach when the value rose since the last assessment of the same rule on the same branch, so a migration holds its ground before the deadline. With no earlier assessment the value is recorded and the rule passes.

stalenessDays.description: Overrides the policy's defaultStalenessDays for this rule.

onStale.description: Overrides the policy's onStale for this rule.

when.description: An extra condition each fact must meet to be counted, over the finding variables.
